intro: Contact Aurora before reserving an appointment if you need a route without steps or have another specific access requirement. sections.heading: Describe the practical requirement first
paragraphs: Tell the team what you need to be able to do: for example, reach the appointment without using stairs, move through an entrance with a mobility aid, or avoid standing while waiting. Name the service you want to discuss as well. Aurora lists VIP Facial, lash appointments, Eyebrow Lamination and the VIP Special with manicure, pedicure and lashes. Reaching the front door and being able to use the setup for your chosen service are separate questions.

sections.heading: Check the route from arrival to the appointment
paragraphs: Give the full destination when asking for directions: Building 40, Shop 10, Azizi Riviera. Ask which entrance to use and whether there are any steps, raised thresholds or other changes in level between the arrival point and the service area. If an alternative route is suggested, have the team explain where it starts and whether you can use it at your appointment time.

If you use a wheelchair or another mobility aid, ask whether the doorway and route have enough clear space for it. Where a measurement matters, request the measurement rather than relying on words such as wide or nearby. If you need a companion, somewhere to wait or access to a toilet during the visit, raise that specific question before travelling.
